15 navanbar 2000 ko astitv men aaya jharkhand is bar apna 26van sthapna divas manane ja raha hai... lekin is bar sthapna divas ka mukhy rajyastariy samaroh 15 navanbar ko nahin, balki 28 navanbar ko ranchi ke khelganv men aayojit hoga... iski vajah hai lok aastha ka mahaparv chhath, jo is bar sthapna divas ke din hi par raha hai
